name: Official Letter
description: Drafts a formal official letter with proper salutation, reference conventions, and formal closing.
prompt_template: Draft a formal official letter using proper government/corporate register. Structure the letter with appropriate salutation, reference line, numbered paragraphs where appropriate, and formal closing. Preserve all factual details from the source material without elaboration.

name: Minutes of Meeting
description: Structures meeting notes into formal minutes with decisions and action items.
prompt_template: Convert the provided meeting notes into formal minutes format. Include attendees, agenda items, decisions made, and action items with their owners and deadlines only where explicitly stated in the source material. Do not invent owners, deadlines, or decisions not present in the input.

name: Inspection Report
description: Structures field inspection findings into a formal report with observations and recommendations.
prompt_template: Structure the inspection findings into a formal report with observations, findings, and recommendations. Preserve all numeric values, measurements, and specific details exactly as stated. Flag missing information rather than inferring or inventing data. Clearly distinguish between what was directly observed versus what requires further investigation.

name: Technical Note
description: Drafts a concise technical memo explaining a topic, decision, or issue for mixed audiences.
prompt_template: Compose a concise technical note suitable for both technical and non-technical readers. Explain the topic or decision clearly, using technical terms only where necessary with brief definitions. Keep the tone professional and the length under 1-2 pages when possible.

name: Management Summary
description: Produces an executive-level summary from longer source material.
prompt_template: Create a concise executive summary of the provided material. Focus on key decisions, impacts, and recommendations. Avoid jargon and use plain language. Include only the most critical facts and recommendations needed for decision-making.

name: Root Cause Analysis
description: Structures RCA from incident information with clear distinction between evidence and inference.
prompt_template: Structure a root cause analysis from the provided incident information. Clearly separate what is evidenced in the source material from what is inference or hypothesis. Present findings as conclusions only when supported by the evidence; mark assumptions and gaps explicitly. Include symptom, timeline, root cause analysis, and recommended corrective actions.

name: Management Dashboard
description: Produces a structured status summary with KPIs from source data.
prompt_template: Create a structured status/KPI summary suitable for management review. Use only the numbers, statuses, and trends present in the source data. Format clearly with sections, metrics, and trends. Do not invent or estimate any values; note gaps or missing data explicitly.

name: Improve Official Language
description: Rewrites text for official register, tone, and clarity without changing meaning.
prompt_template: Rewrite the provided text to conform to official government or corporate register. Adjust tone and phrasing for formality and clarity while preserving all factual content and meaning. Maintain the original structure and intent.

name: Document Comparison
description: Compares two documents and reports differences, additions, and removals.
prompt_template: Compare the two provided documents or excerpts. Report only the differences you can actually see: additions, removals, and changes. Present findings in a clear, structured format. Do not speculate about intent or importance; report factual textual differences only.
